task: Making a chocolate peanut butter protein shake
query: How do I make a chocolate peanut butter protein shake?

goal.title: Blend a peanut butter milk drink
goal.description: Set up a blender, measure milk into its pitcher and add spoonfuls of peanut butter and white supplement powder. Blend the mixture, pour it into a glass, rinse the equipment and drink from the glass.
goal.final_state: A glass of beige foamy drink remains partly filled on the counter after a sip; the pitcher and lid have been rinsed in the sink and the blender base moved back.

procedure.description: Pull the blender base forward, lift the pitcher, remove its lid and seat the pitcher on the base. Set the lid down, open the glassware cupboard, retrieve the Pyrex measuring cup, close that door and set the cup on the counter. Open a pantry cupboard.

Search through the pantry, lifting or shifting several tubs, bags, bottles and storage containers. Take out a mixed nuts tin and a large ingredient tub and set them beside the blender. Reposition the other pantry containers and close the doors. Neither of these two large containers is visibly opened or poured into the blender.

Open the adjacent cupboard and look through its contents. Briefly lift and replace a white-lid jar, move a small jar and retrieve the blue-lid peanut butter jar and black-green supplement tub. Put both on the counter, close the pantry, briefly open the glassware cupboard without taking another item, then retrieve the measuring cup and walk toward the refrigerator.

Open the refrigerator, remove the milk jug and return to the blender counter with the cup. Put the cup down, remove the red milk cap and pour milk into the cup. Replace the milk cap, return the jug to the refrigerator door shelf and close the door. Retrieve the measured milk and tip it into the blender pitcher.

Put the empty measuring cup down, pick up the peanut butter jar, unscrew its blue lid and set the lid down. Open the cutlery drawer and take a large spoon. Scoop a heaped spoonful and shake it repeatedly over the pitcher; scoop again and continue shaking until clumps fall into the milk. Carry the used spoon to the sink and leave it there.

Screw the blue lid onto the peanut butter jar. Open the pantry and return the unused large tub and mixed nuts tin, then close that cupboard. Open the adjacent cupboard and put the peanut butter away, close its door, pick up the supplement tub and walk to the drawer. Open the drawer and retrieve a clean smaller spoon.

Open the black-green supplement tub, scoop a spoonful of white powder and tip it into the blender. Replace and tighten the tub lid. Pick up the empty measuring cup while retaining the spoon and leave both in the sink. Carry the closed supplement tub to the pantry and place it on a shelf. The powder is white and the label appears to say creatine; its composition is not inferred from the task title.

Close the pantry and pick up the blender lid. Attempt to fit it, lift it away and reseat it, then press the handle down until secure. Move a metal canister aside to reach the power strip, handle the blender plug and press the power button. Press further controls; the liquid visibly begins churning around 155.1s.

Keep the left palm on the blender lid while the drink churns. Open the pantry again, look inside without retrieving anything, close both doors and briefly steady the lid again. Withdraw the hands and use a phone, including typing, while the blender continues. Lower the phone and press the blender control to stop it.

Manipulate the lid release and handle, lift the pitcher off the base and carry it to the sink counter with the lid resting on top. Put it down, open the glassware cupboard, take a tall ribbed drinking glass and close the door. Put the glass beside the pitcher, lift the blender lid off and leave the lid in the sink.

Hold the glass in the left hand and tilt the pitcher with the right, pouring the beige foamy drink into the glass. Set the filled glass down. Bring the pitcher into the sink, turn the faucet on and leave the pitcher under the stream. Retrieve the lid, rotate and tilt it under running water to rinse both sides, then lower it into the sink.

Rinse the hands, turn the tap off and dry them on the towel hanging from the oven. Return to the blender and slide its base back on the counter. Pick up the filled glass, raise it to the mouth, drink briefly, then lower and set it on the counter. The video ends with the glass still partly filled.
